title: Embracing Contradiction: Theoretical Inconsistency Will Not Impede the Road of Building Responsible AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct a novel empirical evaluation of bias; instead, it provides a theoretical analysis of mathematical incompatibilities among general fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity, equalized odds) and proposes a documentation protocol (SPHERE-aligned metric provenance sheets) to manage metric inconsistencies.

Examined conceptually as a case study for 'intra-concept inconsistency', drawing on prior empirical evaluations of LLMs to illustrate the trade-offs between different definitions of political neutrality (e.g., refusal vs. reasonable pluralism).
